FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerInstallText: Matomo downloads the connector from its Marketplace, installs it and then activates it.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerManual: This Matomo cannot install plugins from its Marketplace by itself. To install the connector by hand:
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerManualStep2: Unzip it and put the folder FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector into the plugins directory of your Matomo.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3Console: Plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo, so activate the connector on the command line:
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerPasswordNote: As with every plugin install, Matomo first asks for your password if you have not entered it recently.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerPhp: The Feinwerk Connector needs PHP %s or newer. Once your server runs it, you can install the connector here.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.

FeinwerkLiveDashboard.FeedbackThanksDown: Thank you. If you like, describe the problem to our support.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.Help: What happens on your website right now: visits active in the last minutes, the pages they view, a live map, top lists of the time window you choose (3 to 60 minutes) and today's totals. The numbers update every few seconds and count visits by their last activity, so they can differ from Matomo's daily reports.

FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoConnectorLink: Install the Feinwerk Connector from the Matomo Marketplace
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoConnectorText: Exclusive Plugins for Matomo by Feinwerk, free, freemium and premium:
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkLiveDashboard.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
